title: Set 166

sentences.ko: 레시피 하나 찾아보려고 유튜브를 켰을 뿐인데, 어쩌다 보니 새벽 두 시고 밴에서 사는 사람들 영상을 한 열다섯 개는 봤어. 난 밴에서 살고 싶지도 않은데!
sentences.text: I only opened YouTube to look up one recipe, and somehow it's two in the morning and I've watched like fifteen videos about people who live in vans. I don't even want to live in a van!

alts.text: Pulled up YouTube for one recipe, and now it's two in the morning and I'm like fifteen videos deep on people living in vans. I don't even wanna live in a van!
I opened YouTube only to look up a single recipe, and somehow it is now two in the morning and I have watched about fifteen videos about people who live in vans. I do not even want to live in a van!

sentences.note: **look up** 은 정보를 찾아보다라는 뜻입니다. **like fifteen videos** 처럼 숫자 앞의 like 는 한 열다섯 개쯤이라는 대충의 느낌을 줍니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 있잖아, 요즘 내 폰이 좀 이상해. 통화하다가 갑자기 화면이 까맣게 꺼지거든. 그럼 난 전화가 끊긴 줄 아는데 사실은 안 끊긴 거야. 그래서 자꾸 나도 모르게 사람들 전화를 끊어 버려.
sentences.text: Okay, so my phone's been doing this weird thing where the screen just goes black in the middle of a call, and I think the call dropped, but it didn't, so I keep hanging up on people without meaning to.

alts.text: My phone's got this weird glitch. The screen goes black mid-call, so I think it dropped, but it didn't, and I keep hanging up on people by accident.
My phone has been behaving strangely. The screen goes black in the middle of a call, and I assume the call has ended, but it has not, so I keep hanging up on people unintentionally.

sentences.note: **hanging up on people** 은 상대가 말하는 중에 전화를 끊어 버린다는 뜻입니다. **without meaning to** 는 그럴 생각이 없었는데, 즉 나도 모르게라는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 토요일에 드디어 차고를 치우려고 했거든. 이사 온 뒤로 계속 미뤄 왔던 거야. 근데 고등학교 때 물건이 든 상자를 찾는 바람에, 청소는 안 하고 오후 내내 쪽지만 읽었어.
sentences.text: I was finally going to clean out the garage on Saturday, which I've been putting off since we moved in, but I found a box of my old high school stuff, so I basically spent the whole afternoon reading notes instead of cleaning.

alts.text: Saturday I was finally gonna do the garage, been putting it off since we moved in, but then I found a box of my old high school stuff, so I pretty much spent all afternoon reading notes instead.

On Saturday I had finally planned to clean out the garage, which I had been postponing since we moved in. However, I found a box of my old high school belongings, so I spent nearly the entire afternoon reading notes rather than cleaning.

sentences.note: **putting off** 는 하기 싫은 일을 계속 미루다라는 뜻입니다. **clean out** 은 안에 든 것을 싹 정리해서 치운다는 느낌입니다.

sentences.ko: 어머, 이게 얼마 만이야! 아직 그 강가 아파트에 살아? 아니면 맨날 이사 간다더니 드디어 갔어?
sentences.text: Oh my gosh, it's been forever! Are you still in that apartment by the river, or did you finally move like you kept saying you would?

alts.text: Wow, it's been ages! You still at that place by the river, or did you finally move like you kept saying?
It has been such a long time! Are you still living in that apartment by the river, or did you finally move as you kept saying you would?

sentences.note: **it's been forever** 는 정말 오랜만이다라는 뜻으로, 오랜만에 만난 사람에게 반갑게 하는 말입니다. **like you kept saying you would** 는 네가 계속 그러겠다고 했던 것처럼이라는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 있잖아, 걔 진짜 괜찮은 애야. 처음에만 좀 조용해. 그러니까 처음 20분 동안 말이 별로 없어도 바로 별로라고 생각하지 마, 알았지? 일단 편해지면 진짜 웃긴 애야.
sentences.text: So he's a really nice guy, he's just kind of quiet at first, so if he doesn't say much for the first twenty minutes, don't write him off, okay? Once he warms up, he's actually really funny.

alts.text: He's super nice, just kinda quiet at first, so if he barely talks the first twenty minutes, don't write him off, okay? He's hilarious once he warms up.

He is a very kind man, although he tends to be quiet at first. If he does not say much during the first twenty minutes, please do not judge him too quickly. Once he becomes comfortable, he is actually very funny.

sentences.note: **write him off** 는 그 사람을 별 볼 일 없다고 단정하고 마음에서 지워 버린다는 뜻입니다. **warms up** 은 사람이 낯을 풀고 편해진다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구 소개팅 주선하면서 상대가 어떤 사람인지 설명하기

reviewed: 2번: text 의 'I think the call dropped, but it hasn't' 는 시제가 어긋나서 'but it didn't' 로 맞춤
3번: 'I finally cleaned out the garage' 는 다 치웠다는 뜻이라 뒤의 '청소는 안 하고 쪽지만 읽었다'와 모순됨. 'I was finally going to clean out' 으로 고치고 ko·alts도 이에 맞춤
5번: casual 의 뒷문장이 text 와 똑같아서 'He's hilarious once he warms up.' 으로 바꿈
5번: 한국어에 '그러니까'가 두 번 나와 어색해서 자연스럽게 다듬음
